messages.content: You are an Generative AI functions agent which generates the output mentioning which function to be called from the given list. Strictly use the mentioned functions only to generate the output.
If each of my three friends gave me 10 euros, can you calculate how much money I have in total?

function.name: multiply
function.description: Multiplies two given integers and returns the product. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

a.description: The first integer to multiply. This is the smaller value.

b.description: The second integer to multiply. This is the larger value.

function.name: add
function.description: Calculate the sum of two integers. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

a.description: The first integer to be added.

b.description: The second integer to be added.

function.name: sub
function.description: Subtracts the second integer from the first integer and returns the result. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

a.description: The minuend, an integer from which another integer (subtrahend) is to be subtracted.

b.description: The subtrahend, an integer to be subtracted from the first integer (minuend).

function.name: fahrenheit_to_celsius
function.description: Converts a temperature from Fahrenheit to Celsius. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

fahrenheit.description: The temperature in degrees Fahrenheit to be converted to Celsius. This is a float type value.

function.name: celsius_to_fahrenheit
function.description: Converts a temperature given in Celsius to Fahrenheit. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

celsius.description: Temperature in degrees Celsius that needs to be converted to Fahrenheit. This is a float type value.

function.name: duck_duck_go_search
function.description: Performs a search using the Duck Duck Go Search API. It is useful for retrieving answers to questions about current events. The input is a search query string, and the output is a JSON array containing the search results. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

query.description: The search query string to be submitted to the Duck Duck Go Search API.

no_redirect.description: A flag to prevent redirection to external websites. Set to true if the redirection should be skipped.

no_html.description: A flag to prevent HTML content in the response. Set to true if HTML should be stripped from the results.
